build_resnet_backbone_custom: build a ResNet backbone from config with configurable depth, normalization, and deformable conv support
create_ResNet_make_stage: create a list of ResNet blocks forming one stage with configurable stride and dilation per block
create_ResNet_make_default_stages: create default ResNet stages from pre-defined depth of 18, 34, 50, 101, or 152
create_BasicStem: create the standard ResNet stem with a 7x7 conv, relu, and max pooling layer
create_BottleneckBlock: create a bottleneck residual block with 1x1, 3x3, 1x1 conv layers for ResNet-50 and deeper
